answer: Give every newcomer a delayed-settlement haven: new identities may act, but rewards and transfers settle only after a public challenge window of several epochs, when any node may post a fraud proof. Like a bridge opened only after inspection, value crosses only if no challenge stands. A walnut-sized random sample of newcomer actions is re-verified by strangers; one proven fraud reverses that window's gains and bans the identity. A Sybil farmer must keep thousands of fakes clean, with capital locked for weeks and nothing extracted quickly, while an honest user waits once, then acts freely.
